verdict.rationale: CrewAI's enterprise (AMP) introduction lists a "Webhook Streaming" feature to "stream real-time events and updates to your systems," so event subscription via webhooks exists. The only evidence is a one-line feature-list mention, and it appears to be limited to the managed AMP platform rather than the open-source framework. Missing for 10: documentation of how to register or configure webhook subscriptions, the catalog of event types, payload and delivery semantics (retries, signing), availability outside the AMP tier, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
